points.description: Correct final answer of 3430 people infected after three days, supported by a valid calculation (e.g. multiplying by 7 each day: 10 × 7 × 7 × 7, or 10 → 70 → 490 → 3430). Equivalent wording and correct alternative methods earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Full marks require a mathematically valid method and the correct final answer of 3430. A single wrong step or a wrong final answer earns nothing, since the mark is all-or-nothing.
